title: Cream of Wheat, Instant, Made with Water, Fat Added

content.title: About
content.content: Cream of Wheat is a quick‑cooking breakfast made from milled wheat, prepared with water and added fat. It has a mild, creamy flavor, a smooth texture, and is often used as a convenient, nutritious alternative to traditional hot cereals.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The first instant wheat cereal was introduced in the United States in the early 20th century.
The wheat used is specially processed to dissolve rapidly in hot water.
Added fat improves taste and boosts the product’s energy content.
It is commonly served with fruit, nuts, honey, or cinnamon.
Unlike many processed breakfast cereals, it contains no artificial colors or flavors.

items.title: Rich in complex carbohydrates
items.content: Provides slowly digestible carbs that deliver steady energy throughout the morning.

items.title: Source of iron
items.content: Wheat is a good source of iron, essential for oxygen transport in the blood.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamin B1, B2, and niacin support metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: A modest amount of dietary fiber helps maintain regular bowel movements.

items.title: Easy to prepare
items.content: Dissolves quickly in hot water, making it ideal for busy lifestyles.

items.title: Wheat allergy
items.content: People with wheat allergy or celiac disease may experience adverse reactions.

items.title: Added fat content
items.content: Increases caloric density; portion control is advisable for those watching weight.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Can raise blood sugar quickly, so individuals with diabetes should consume it cautiously.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Pour 250 ml of hot water over the cereal, stir until smooth, and let stand for 1–2 minutes. Optionally top with fruit, berries, nuts, honey, or cinnamon for extra flavor and nutrition.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in a tightly sealed package. After opening, use within 3–4 weeks to preserve flavor and prevent moisture absorption.
